scope: process-only certificate and schema transport; no scientific or ledger movement

contract.historical_snapshot: each certificate keeps its exact named ledger and version-local evidence immutable
contract.current_authority: the live research-evidence contract names one append-only standing ledger
contract.ancestry_proof: walk predecessor edges from the live standing ledger to each exact historical snapshot
superseded_checks_removed: historical ledger remains the live standing pointer
historical directive remains the active scientific directive
historical native front door remains current
contract.frontmatter_custody: new process reports use the typed process role and the protected population manifest matches the exact tracked mapping

validation.cohort_before: 0/15 green under mutable historical current-state expectations
validation.cohort_after: 15/15 green under historical snapshot plus append-only ancestry
validation.frontmatter_before: 3 failures: population drift, mapping drift and one new untyped legacy status
validation.frontmatter_after: 0 failures plus 3/3 planted population mutations caught

hostile_review.strongest_overclaim: ancestry proves durable historical custody, not that an old directive remains current or that any scientific grade increased
hostile_review.strongest_contrary_case: removing old directive checks could delete real version-local science; all scientific payload, source, review, accounting, result and inventory assertions remain and were replayed
hostile_review.weakest_reproducibility_seam: all gates share one ancestry predicate and frontmatter custody depends on an exact tracked mapping; the four ancestry controls and three schema mutations therefore run with the cohort

reopen_only_on: a broken or missing predecessor edge
a historical target skipped by the live chain
a new frontmatter population or mapping drift
